newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse down hit by U.S. holiday.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse down hit by U.S. holiday.

text.p: 1144 GMT - German equities end lacklustre bourse session half-a-percentage point lower, as U.S. Labor Day holiday takes impetus out of trade. Sentiment dampened by soft German debt, lower close on Wall St Friday. Stable dollar underpins trade, volumes low in the absence of new influences to lift sentiment.
* September DAX future unchanged at 2,539 points.
* VW lower after newspaper report of high incidence of problems with cars produced at its Wolfsburg plant.
* Lufthansa down after news of cartel office probe into its pricing structure on domestic routes.
